title: GTA6 Community Wishlist: What Players Hope to See in Future Showcases
description: Explore the latest Reddit r/GTA6 community discussion detailing a wishlist of features, missions, and open-world mechanics players hope to see in upcoming updates.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Community Wishlist: What Players Hope to See in Future Showcases

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' *Grand Theft Auto VI* continues to build, the r/GTA6 Reddit community has been actively discussing what could potentially be revealed next. A notable post by user /u/Pistoluislero has sparked widespread conversation, outlining a detailed list of features, gameplay mechanics, and world details that fans are hoping to see in upcoming official showcases.

It is important to note that this list originates from a community forum and represents **unconfirmed rumors and player speculation**, rather than official Rockstar announcements. Nevertheless, the discussion provides a fascinating look at what the core fanbase expects from the next evolution of the open-world franchise.

### Key Gameplay Mechanics on the Community Radar

The community-driven wishlist covers several crucial aspects of gameplay and technical design that players are eager to evaluate:

- **Mission Showcase**: A structured look at how missions play out in the new setting.
- **Combat Mechanics**: Detailed breakdowns of shooting and close-quarters combat.
- **Police and Wanted System**: How law enforcement AI and the wanted system will function in the modern era of the game.
- **Dynamic Character Switching**: The ability to switch between Jason and Lucia seamlessly during gameplay.
- **NPC Interactions**: Enhanced NPC behaviors and overall world immersion details.
- **Driving Physics**: Upgraded vehicle handling, realistic car damage, and vehicle variety.
- **Random Encounters**: World events and spontaneous activities scattered across the map.

### Open-World Exploration and Big Surprises

Beyond specific mechanics, players are hoping for raw gameplay footage of free roam to properly showcase the scale and variety of the crafted open world and its diverse map locations.

Additionally, the community holds out hope for a major surprise that Rockstar has yet to reveal—such as what lies up north, or the potential inclusion of another city. While these grand ideas remain purely speculative at this stage, they highlight the high expectations surrounding the game's scope.

### Editor's Take

This community wishlist captures the excitement and high standards surrounding GTA6. While none of these points are officially confirmed yet, they accurately reflect the features fans care about most. We will have to wait for Rockstar to show their hand to see which of these expectations become reality.
